sections.heading: Vantage and timing
sections.text: W-B observed the yoke guide from the drive side near 13:20. The carrier/post contact and keeper were obscured.

sections.heading: Account
sections.text: The yoke was lower than its earlier chalk reference. I could not tell whether the carrier had moved with it. I heard the impact later.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: The observer cannot quantify displacement or identify the release path. A moving yoke and a stationary carrier are compatible observations of different objects.
